2607.01733.title: Rethinking Speech-LLM Integration for ASR: Effective Joint Speech-Text Training by Interleaving
2607.01733.paper_summary: Speech-LLM integration has shown promising results by leveraging extensive textual pretraining, yet its specific benefits for automatic speech recognition (ASR) remain unclear. We observe that as supervised ASR training data increases, the contribution of LLM priors becomes less evident, and simple speech-text joint training under-utilizes textual knowledge. We therefore propose Joint Speech-Text Interleaved Pretraining (JSTIP), an ASR-oriented pretraining strategy that constructs word-level and segment-level interleaved speech-text sequences within aligned pairs for speech-LLM architectures that accept continuous inputs. Experiments on 38k hours of ASR data show consistent entity accuracy improvement compared to ASR-only and joint speech-text training baselines. JSTIP achieves on-par entity recognition performance using domain transcription text compared to synthetic speech-text pairs, simplifying domain adaptation. Benefiting from textual pretraining and domain text data, JSTIP is competitive with open-source ASR and Speech-LLM systems in medical entity recognition. The zero-shot speech question answering behaviors further suggest that interleaving reduces the speech-text modality gap and preserves the LLM generative prior, which is likely the reason for the entity improvements on the ASR task.
2607.01733.paper_summary_zh: 語音-大型語言模型整合透過利用廣泛的文本預訓練顯示出有希望的結果，但其對自動語音識別（ASR）的具體好處仍不明確。<lb/>我們觀察到，隨著監督式ASR訓練數據的增加，LLM先驗的貢獻變得不那麼明顯，而簡單的語音-文本聯合訓練未能充分利用文本知識。<lb/>因此，我們提出了聯合語音-文本交錯預訓練（JSTIP），這是一種面向ASR的預訓練策略，旨在構建在對齊對中交錯的字級和段級語音-文本序列，以適應接受連續輸入的語音-LLM架構。<lb/>在38k小時的ASR數據上的實驗顯示，與僅ASR和聯合語音-文本訓練基準相比，實體準確性持續改善。<lb/>JSTIP在使用領域轉錄文本時達到了與合成語音-文本對相當的實體識別性能，簡化了領域適應。<lb/>受益於文本預訓練和領域文本數據，JSTIP在醫療實體識別方面與開源ASR和語音-LLM系統具有競爭力。<lb/>零-shot語音問題回答行為進一步表明，交錯可以減少語音-文本模態差距並保留LLM生成先驗，這可能是ASR任務上實體改進的原因。
